camel_example: aliyun vpc ListVpnCertificateAssociations --region cn-hangzhou --CertificateType Signature --NextToken caeba0bbb2be00000 --VpnGatewayId.1 'vpn-bp1q8bgx4xnkm2ogj0000' --MaxResults 10 --CertificateId.1 8480000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Queries the associations between VPN gateway instances and certificates in a specified region
description_zh: 调用ListVpnCertificateAssociations接口查询指定地域下VPN网关实例和证书的绑定关系
kebab_example: aliyun vpc list-vpn-certificate-associations --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --certificate-type Signature --next-token caeba0bbb2be00000 --max-results 10 --vpn-gateway-id vpn-bp1q8bgx4xnkm2ogj0000 --certificate-id 8480000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListVpnCertificateAssociations

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPN gateway.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
VPN网关所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The certificate type. Valid values:

Encryption: encryption certificate.

Signature: signing certificate
parameters.help_zh:
证书类型。取值：

Encryption：加密证书。

Signature：签名证书
parameters.name: certificate_type

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token. Valid values:

If this is the first query or no subsequent query exists, leave this parameter empty.

If a subsequent query exists, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。

如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 20. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~20，默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The list of VPN gateway instance IDs.

You can query the associations between up to 20 VPN gateway instances and SSL certificates at a time
parameters.help_zh:
VPN网关实例ID列表。

一次最多支持查询20个VPN网关实例与SSL证书的绑定关系
parameters.name: vpn_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of certificate IDs.

You can query the associations between up to 20 SSL certificates and VPN gateway instances at a time
parameters.help_zh:
证书ID列表。

一次最多支持查询20个SSL证书与VPN网关实例的绑定关系
parameters.name: certificate_id

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries per page
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数

NextToken.description_en:
The pagination token. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no subsequent query exists.

If NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。

如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

AssociationTime.description_en:
The time when the association was created.

The time is displayed in UTC in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format
AssociationTime.description_zh:
绑定时间。

时间按照ISO8601标准表示，并使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

CertificateType.description_en:
The certificate type.

Encryption: encryption certificate.

Signature: signing certificate
CertificateType.description_zh:
证书类型。

Encryption：加密证书。

Signature：签名证书

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the VPN gateway
